notes: Label at the top reads HANIFIELD (no suffix visible in strip; Street assumed). Hanifield's north edge is cut off by the plate edge: centre taken about 100 px north of the south edge, near the solid water-pipe line; Jerome crossing sits at the very top of the plate. Jerome and Florida appear to continue north of Hanifield to the plate edge. A short line with a hydrant and a lot line going north near (3285,250) may be another street off Hanifield's north side (text GEO...), not picked. Hoffner Avenue is drawn as a narrow strip here (25 ft west of Sylvan, 30 ft between Sylvan and Edgewood, 55 ft east of Edgewood); y taken at the middle of the drawn strip. Powers Street's south edge is off the plate: centre y estimated 75 px south of its north edge (y 7132); whether Sylvan and Edgewood continue south of Powers cannot be seen (Edgewood's sewer dashes do continue). Sylvan and Edgewood each exist as a short piece south of Colerain and a long piece from Hoffner to Powers, nothing between (Byron Kirby Heirs land, creek). Kearsarge Avenue's crossing with the north-south street at x about 1815 is outside the 1940 limit.
